The year '''9349 BBY before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the [[Ductavis Era]].

==Events==
*The [[House Korden|Korden family]], a wealthy family that owned the firm [[Korden Outfitting and Surveying]], became officially known as "House Korden".
